_comment: How this instance is configured. `document`, not `paper`: there is no Lean and no TeX here, only structured prose and JSON nodes, so the paper adapter's LaTeX-shaped QA axes would fire on content that never reaches pdflatex. The platform is litlfred/folio-assistant, used from a separate checkout. It is NOT vendored here: `src/tools/validate.py` finds it via $FOLIO_ASSISTANT.
